hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: My diary, my heart beats in the shadows. I was sweeping the hearth, my feet tapping a private tune. I loosened my stays, feeling a pulse in my chest. Then, I heard whispers and saw the dim light cast shadows on two silhouettes. What secrets are they keeping? Curiosity drives me, and my curiosity grows. Tonight, I must uncover what lies beyond the curtains.
caption:
A secret diary, a hidden romance.
